newsitem.headline: TABLE - Tosco Corp Q2 shr $0.43 vs $0.41.

text.p: (Unaudited, thousands of Dollars, Except Per Share Data)
Three Months Ended June 30, Six Months Ended June 30,
Earnings per common and common equivalent share

(1) Tosco completed its acquisitions of Unocal's West Coast petroleum refining, marketing, and related supply and transportation assets on March 31, 1997 (the "Unocal Acquisition") and Circle K on May 30, 1996 (the "Circle K Acquisition").

The company said sales increases were primarily due to the Unocal and Circle K acquisitions and the reopening of the Trainer Refinery on May 8, 1997 net of reduced production at the Avon and Bayway Refineries and lower West Coast product prices during the second quarter of 1997.
The 1996 operating results include a $13.5 million $8.1 million after-tax charge for the consolidation of Tosco's marketing division following the completion of the Circle K acquisition.

The earnings per share amounts reflect the 3-for-1 stock split declared and distributed in February 1997. On June 30, 1997, Tosco paid a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per common share to shareholders of record on June 20, 1997.
